fact: Econet Ai, a subsidiary of Econet Wireless Zimbabwe, runs the Shona-language chatbot Yamurai, which the company says already handles more than 70% of customer enquiries.
Econet Ai is building a Ndebele-speaking chatbot trained on thousands of hours of recorded Ndebele speech, to launch in phases from September 2026.
Techzim reports that Econet AI, launched in April 2026, is working on local language AI, including making its Yamurai assistant sound more Zimbabwean.
